title: Middlemarch
author: George Eliot
summary: Set in a provincial English town around 1830, this novel follows idealistic Dorothea Brooke, the ambitious doctor Lydgate and other residents. Marriage, money, reform and personal ambition shape their disappointments and hopes.
readIf: you want a long, richly observed Victorian novel with a large cast and moral depth.
skipIf: you prefer brisk plots, since it is long and digressive.
